steps.name: Install Node.js 22.1.0
steps.command:
#!/bin/bash -eo pipefail
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# shellcheck disable=SC2016

# Only install nvm if it's not already installed
if command -v nvm &> /dev/null; then
    echo "nvm is already installed. Skipping nvm install.";
else
    curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.39.3/install.sh | bash;
    
    echo 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"' >> "$BASH_ENV";
    echo '[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" --no-use' >> "$BASH_ENV";
    
    # shellcheck source=/dev/null
    source "$BASH_ENV";
fi

# See: https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm#usage
if [ "$NODE_PARAM_VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
    # When no version is specified we default to the latest version of Node
    NODE_ORB_INSTALL_VERSION=$(nvm ls-remote | tail -n1 | grep -Eo 'v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+')
    nvm install "$NODE_ORB_INSTALL_VERSION" # aka nvm install node. We're being explicit here.
    nvm alias default "$NODE_ORB_INSTALL_VERSION"
elif [ -n "$NODE_PARAM_VERSION" ] && [ "$NODE_PARAM_VERSION" != "lts" ]; then
    nvm install "$NODE_PARAM_VERSION"
    nvm alias default "$NODE_PARAM_VERSION"
elif [ -f ".nvmrc" ]; then
    NVMRC_SPECIFIED_VERSION=$(<.nvmrc)
    nvm install "$NVMRC_SPECIFIED_VERSION"
    nvm alias default "$NVMRC_SPECIFIED_VERSION"
else
    nvm install --lts
    nvm alias default lts/*
fi

echo 'nvm use default &>/dev/null' >> "$BASH_ENV"

steps.name: install libvips
Install Bundler and gems
steps.command:
#!/bin/bash -eo pipefail
echo 'export BUNDLER_VERSION=$(cat Gemfile.lock | tail -1 | tr -d " ")' >> $BASH_ENV
source $BASH_ENV
# Pin to the lockfile's version: Ruby 4.0 ships Bundler 4.x as default gem,
# which BUNDLER_VERSION cannot activate.
gem install bundler -v "$BUNDLER_VERSION"
bundle config set path 'vendor/bundle'
bundle install --jobs=4 --retry=3
bundle clean

steps.name: yarn install --frozen-lockfile --cache-folder ~/.cache/yarn
steps.command:
#!/bin/bash -eo pipefail
yarn install --frozen-lockfile --cache-folder ~/.cache/yarn

steps.name: Set up assets cache key
steps.command:
#!/bin/bash -eo pipefail
find app/javascript -type f -exec md5sum {} \; > assets_checksum

steps.name: Compile assets
steps.command:
#!/bin/bash -eo pipefail
bundle exec rails assets:precompile

steps.name: bundle exec rails db:schema:load
steps.command:
#!/bin/bash -eo pipefail
bundle exec rails db:schema:load

steps.name: run tests
steps.command:
#!/bin/bash -eo pipefail
mkdir ~/rspec
circleci tests glob "spec/**/*_spec.rb" | \
circleci tests run --command=" \
  xargs bundle exec rspec \
    --tag ~benchmark \
    --format progress \
    --format documentation \
    --out ~/rspec/rspec-documentation.txt \
    --format json \
    --out ~/rspec/rspec.json \
    --format RspecJunitFormatter \
    --out ~/rspec/rspec.xml" \
  --verbose \
  --split-by=timings

#!/bin/bash -eo pipefail
mkdir ~/rspec
circleci tests glob "spec/**/*_spec.rb" | \
circleci tests run --command=" \
  xargs bundle exec rspec \
    --tag ~benchmark \
    --format progress \
    --format documentation \
    --out ~/rspec/rspec-documentation.txt \
    --format json \
    --out ~/rspec/rspec.json \
    --format RspecJunitFormatter \
    --out ~/rspec/rspec.xml" \
  --verbose \
  --split-by=timings

steps.name: Install Node.js 22.1.0
steps.command:
#!/bin/bash -eo pipefail
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# shellcheck disable=SC2016

# Only install nvm if it's not already installed
if command -v nvm &> /dev/null; then
    echo "nvm is already installed. Skipping nvm install.";
else
    curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.39.3/install.sh | bash;
    
    echo 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"' >> "$BASH_ENV";
    echo '[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" --no-use' >> "$BASH_ENV";
    
    # shellcheck source=/dev/null
    source "$BASH_ENV";
fi

# See: https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm#usage
if [ "$NODE_PARAM_VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
    # When no version is specified we default to the latest version of Node
    NODE_ORB_INSTALL_VERSION=$(nvm ls-remote | tail -n1 | grep -Eo 'v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+')
    nvm install "$NODE_ORB_INSTALL_VERSION" # aka nvm install node. We're being explicit here.
    nvm alias default "$NODE_ORB_INSTALL_VERSION"
elif [ -n "$NODE_PARAM_VERSION" ] && [ "$NODE_PARAM_VERSION" != "lts" ]; then
    nvm install "$NODE_PARAM_VERSION"
    nvm alias default "$NODE_PARAM_VERSION"
elif [ -f ".nvmrc" ]; then
    NVMRC_SPECIFIED_VERSION=$(<.nvmrc)
    nvm install "$NVMRC_SPECIFIED_VERSION"
    nvm alias default "$NVMRC_SPECIFIED_VERSION"
else
    nvm install --lts
    nvm alias default lts/*
fi

echo 'nvm use default &>/dev/null' >> "$BASH_ENV"
